name: quit-sidebar-focus
description: Cmd+Q with key focus in the HTML sidebar (a views::WebView on the system-profile chrome context) rather than the content pane. Written to test the hypothesis that the sidebar surface swallowed the quit keystroke; that hypothesis was WRONG. It failed because its Escape was the only one in the matrix that actually dismissed the command palette, exposing the real cause - a tabless window's IDC_EXIT being claimed and dropped. Kept as coverage of the sidebar-focus state, which nothing else exercises. It has a dismissal and gates proving the palette is out of the way, so a pass means the sidebar-focused quit really was tested.

actions.note: let the empty space render and the palette auto-open - it appears 3.9-5.0s after launch on this VM, so the old 3000ms was racing it
first dismiss attempt; unreliable on its own, hence the scrim click below
give the Escape time to land
second dismiss attempt - a press on the palette's scrim, outside the panel and clear of the 280px sidebar. Same pair quit-empty-no-palette.json needed
let the palette close and key focus return to the browser window

THE VARIABLE: click the sidebar body (sidebarWidth 280, so x=140 is its horizontal centre; y=430 is below the space rail, in the empty tab-list region of a space with no tabs) to move key focus into the HTML chrome surface
let focus settle in the sidebar WebContents
evidence of where the click landed and what holds focus

assertions.label: palette-dismissed
assertions.note: Proves the palette really closed before the sidebar click, so the click landed on the sidebar rather than on the palette's scrim.

assertions.desc: Cmd+Q quits with key focus in the HTML sidebar (system-profile chrome WebContents)

assertions.label: not-the-palette-route
assertions.pattern: Atrium: palette passing key-equivalent to main menu
assertions.note: Listed AFTER the quit assertion on purpose: the run log is pulled before assertions run, so a line Cmd+Q itself emits is only in the log that assert_quit re-pulls. Placed before it, this gate could never match - and a vlog_absent one would pass trivially, which is exactly the vacuous shape to avoid.
